items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 206:1
items.html: The ascent of the Musaf [additional prayer] of Shabbat is like the first aspect of the First Man, which he had at the time of his birth. (Item 99).
